VI.description: Opens a handle to the process process ID through kernel32.dll OpenProcess (stdcall\2C called in any thread). RemoteVI asks only for PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION (0x1000)\2C which is enough to read the program's path (kernel32 QueryFullProcessImageNameW.vi) and is granted for most processes of the same user. HANDLE is 0 on failure. Close it with kernel32 CloseHandle.vi. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
